heading.en: Jesus provides bread and wine miraculously and again administers the sacrament unto the people—The remnant of Jacob will come to the knowledge of the Lord their God and will inherit the Americas—Jesus is the prophet like unto Moses, and the Nephites are children of the prophets—Others of the Lord's people will be gathered to Jerusalem. About A.D. 34.
heading.sm: Ua saunia e Iesu le areto ma le uaina i se ala faavavega ma ua toe faamanuia ma tufatufa atu le faamanatuga i tagata—O le a aumai le vaega o totoe o Iakopo i le malamalama o le Alii lo latou Atua, ma o le a fai mo o latou tofi le laueleele o Amerika—O Iesu o le perofeta e pei o Mose, ma o tagata sa Nifaē o fanau a perofeta—O isi o tagata o le Alii o le a faapotopotoina i Ierusalema. E tusa o le 34 T.A.
